matter_background.original: Kapila Perera is the owner of house and property situated at No.96, Quarry Road, Dehiwala. At present he is living with his daughter in Maharagama. Therefore he advertised to Lease his house to a suitable Lessee at a monthly rental of Rs.75,000/- for two years which rent should be paid on the 20th day of each and every month commencing from January 2017. He wants a refundable deposit of Rs. 300,000/- and an advance payment of Rs 900,000/- to be set off against the 2nd year rental. He wants to retain you as his Lawyer and Notary to prepare the Lease document.
